name: safevision-shipped-assets
description: The clips that ship with the repository. This is a PROBE set, not an evaluation set: it exists to prove the harness runs end to end and to document exactly why no accuracy figure can be quoted. Every clip here is either synthetic or a single provisional event.

clips.label: accident
clips.note: Real footage, 505 frames @30fps. The single accident event was located by watching the pipeline's own state transitions, NOT by independent review - so using it to score the pipeline is circular. Counts as evidence that the system runs, not as ground truth.

events.note: Window bracketing the SUSPICIOUS->VERIFYING->CONFIRMED transitions observed at ~frame 57-155. NOT independently verified.

clips.label: normal
clips.note: Generated drawing, 90 frames. YOLO finds no real objects in it. Cannot measure detector quality in either direction.

clips.label: normal
clips.note: Generated drawing, 90 frames. No real objects; a negative here is guaranteed by construction and proves nothing about false alarms.
